#
# Script contains analysis to compute retention of reads throughout the different
# LongAIRR processing steps determined by the summary.tsv generated during
# LongAIRR processing for each dataset.
#
# We compare additional Visium V1 samples supporting Fig. 2e (S1_ONT_Q17, S2_ONT_Q17, S3_ONT_Q17)
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Fig. S1
#
########################################

----------------

read in summary.tsv from longairr
```{r}
samples_list <- list(
  S1_ONT_Q17 = summary_sp12,
  S2_ONT_Q17 = summary_sp07,
  S3_ONT_Q17 = summary_sp08)

# input parameters
samples <- tibble::tibble(
  sample      = names(samples_list),
  summary_tsv = unname(unlist(samples_list)),
  add_total   = TRUE,
  keep_branch = "both",
  col         = c("#1F77B4", "#2CA02C", "#D62728"))

sample_list <- samples$sample
sample_cols <- setNames(samples$col, samples$sample)

# read in summary.tsv for visium v1 samples
read_summary_visium <- function(file, samplename,
                               add_total_in_from_filtering = TRUE,
                               keep_branch = c("both","TCR","Ig")) {

  keep_branch <- match.arg(keep_branch)

  raw <- read_delim(file, delim = "\t", skip = 2, col_types = cols(.default = readr::col_character()), trim_ws = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(across(c(Step, PathInfo, InputDescription, OutputDescription), str_squish),
      Step = str_remove(Step, "^>"),
      InputReads = as.numeric(InputReads),
      OutputReads = as.numeric(OutputReads))

  filtering <- raw %>%
    filter(Step == "Filtering") %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  consensus <- raw %>%
    filter(Step == "Collapse", PathInfo == "Consensus") %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  shared <- tibble(Step = c("Filter_out", "Group_sets"), PathInfo = NA_character_,
    OutputReads = c(filtering$OutputReads, consensus$OutputReads))

  # add TOTAL_IN info (Input column in the Filter_out row)
  if (add_total_in_from_filtering) {
    shared <- bind_rows(tibble(Step="Total_in", PathInfo=NA_character_, OutputReads=filtering$InputReads), shared)}

  seqtag <- raw %>%
    filter(Step == "Seqtag", PathInfo %in% c("Ig","TCR")) %>%
    transmute(Step = "Seqtag_out", PathInfo, OutputReads)

  airr_out <- raw %>%
    filter(Step == "AIRR", PathInfo %in% c("Ig","TCR"),
      str_detect(OutputDescription, regex("^Sequences with valid V\\(D\\)J annotation$", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
    transmute(Step = "AIRR_out", PathInfo, OutputReads)

  airr_prod <- raw %>%
    filter(Step == "AIRRRate", PathInfo %in% c("Ig","TCR")) %>%
    transmute(Step = "AIRR_prod", PathInfo, OutputReads)

  branches <- bind_rows(seqtag, airr_out, airr_prod)

  # keep only one branch post-split // e.g. only TCR or BCR
  if (keep_branch != "both") {
    branches <- branches %>%
      filter(PathInfo == keep_branch)
  }

  # annotation to split lines into loci-branches
  bind_rows(shared, branches) %>%
    mutate(sample = samplename,
      sample_receptor = case_when(
        PathInfo == "TCR" ~ paste0(sample, "_TCR"),
        PathInfo == "Ig"  ~ paste0(sample, "_BCR"),
        TRUE              ~ paste0(sample, "_BCR"))) #shared rows
}

```


#-------use functions

```{r}
steps_levels <- c("Total_in","Filter_out","Group_sets","Seqtag_out","AIRR_out","AIRR_prod")

df_visium <- samples %>%
  mutate(data = map2(summary_tsv,
                     sample,~ read_summary_visium(.x, .y,
                                                  add_total_in_from_filtering = TRUE,
                                                  keep_branch = keep_branch[samples$sample == .y]))) %>%
  pull(data) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(Step   = factor(Step, levels = steps_levels),
         sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_list))

```

data wrangling to include different line types
```{r}
umi_rows <- df_visium %>%
  filter(Step == "Group_sets") %>%
  distinct(sample, OutputReads, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_visium <- df_visium %>%
  filter(Step != "Group_sets") %>%
  bind_rows(umi_rows %>% mutate(sample_receptor = paste0(sample, "_BCR")),
            umi_rows %>% mutate(sample_receptor = paste0(sample, "_TCR"))) %>%
  mutate(receptor  = if_else(str_detect(sample_receptor, "TCR"), "TCR", "BCR"),
         is_shared = Step %in% c("Total_in", "Filter_out", "Group_sets"),
         is_post   = Step %in% c("Group_sets", "Seqtag_out", "AIRR_out", "AIRR_prod"))
```

retention curves figure
```{r}
# positions for line-type legends
key_x0 <- 1
key_y0 <- min(df_visium$OutputReads, na.rm = TRUE) * 40

receptor_key <- tibble::tibble(
  x1    = key_x0,
  x2    = key_x0 + 0.46,
  x_lab = key_x0 + 0.50,
  y     = key_y0 * c(0.95, 0.3, 0.1),
  label = c("Shared processing", "BCR only", "TCR only"),
  lty   = c("solid", "longdash", "dotdash"),
  lwd   = c(1.75, 1, 1))

split_label_y <- max(df_visium$OutputReads, na.rm = TRUE) / 2.5

spatial_retention <- ggplot(df_visium, aes(Step, OutputReads, group = sample_receptor)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35, color = "grey65") +
  geom_line(data = df_visium %>% filter(is_shared) %>% mutate(group_shared = sample),
            aes(color = sample, group = group_shared), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_line(data = df_visium %>% filter(is_post), aes(color = sample, linetype = receptor), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sample), size = 1.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = "Raw reads", vjust = 1.3, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 4.5, y = Inf, label = "Consensus sequences", vjust = 1.3, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = sample_cols) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(BCR = "longdash", TCR = "dotdash")) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
    breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 9)) +
  guides(linetype = "none", color = guide_legend(byrow = TRUE)) +
  labs(y = "Number of reads", x = NULL, color = "Sample") +
  theme_panel2_main +
  theme(
  axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
  axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
  legend.position = "right",
  legend.direction = "vertical",
  #legend.background = element_rect(fill = "gray91", color = NA),
  #legend.key.height = unit(0.28, "cm"),
  #legend.key.width  = unit(0.45, "cm"),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
  panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
  plot.margin  = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 0)) +
  geom_label(data = tibble(x = 3.5, y = 2000000.15, label = "Split by locus"),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.6, hjust = 0, fill = "gray91", label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.10, "lines")) +
  geom_segment(data = receptor_key, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = receptor_key$lwd * 0.65, linetype  = receptor_key$lty, colour = "black") +
  geom_label(data = receptor_key, aes(x = x_lab, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 2.6, fill = "gray91", label.size = 0,
    label.padding = unit(0.08, "lines"), label.r = unit(0.12, "lines"))
```


------build table with retention numbers

```{r}
extract_outputs <- function(df, pathinfo, umi_index = 1) {
  c(Total_in   = df$OutputReads[df$Step == "Total_in"][1],
    Filter_out = df$OutputReads[df$Step == "Filter_out"][1],
    Group_sets = df$OutputReads[df$Step == "Group_sets"][umi_index],
    Seqtag_out = df$OutputReads[df$Step == "Seqtag_out" & df$PathInfo == pathinfo][1],
    AIRR_out   = df$OutputReads[df$Step == "AIRR_out"   & df$PathInfo == pathinfo][1],
    AIRR_prod  = df$OutputReads[df$Step == "AIRR_prod"  & df$PathInfo == pathinfo][1])
}
```

```{r}
sample_order <- c("S1_ONT_Q17", "S2_ONT_Q17", "S3_ONT_Q17")

# match umi row in the table to corresponding loci
branches <- tribble(
  ~sample,      ~branch, ~umi_index,
  "S1_ONT_Q17",  "Ig",     1,
  "S1_ONT_Q17",  "TCR",    2,
  "S2_ONT_Q17",  "Ig",     1,
  "S2_ONT_Q17",  "TCR",    2,
  "S3_ONT_Q17",  "Ig",     1,
  "S3_ONT_Q17",  "TCR",    2) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_order), branch = factor(branch, levels = c("Ig", "TCR"))) %>%
  arrange(sample, branch)
```



```{r}
table_numeric <- branches %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(values = list(
      extract_outputs(
        df_visium %>% dplyr::filter(.data$sample == .env$sample),
        pathinfo  = as.character(branch),
        umi_index = umi_index))) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(values) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Sample_display = dplyr::case_when(branch == "Ig" ~ paste0(as.character(sample), ": BCR"), TRUE ~ "TCR"))

# collapse for same dataset (identical number up until seqtag_out)
cols_to_collapse <- c("Total_in", "Filter_out", "Group_sets")

# which samples have BOTH Ig and TCR rows?
samples_with_both <- table_numeric %>%
  distinct(sample, branch) %>%
  dplyr::count(sample) %>%
  filter(n == 2) %>%
  pull(sample)

# add "" in TCR rows
table_display <- table_numeric %>%
  mutate(do_collapse = (branch == "TCR") & (sample %in% samples_with_both)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_to_collapse),
           ~ if_else(do_collapse, "\"", as.character(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(sample, branch, umi_index, Sample_display, do_collapse),
           ~ if_else(is.na(.x), "/", as.character(.x)))) %>%
  select(-do_collapse)


tbl_df <- table_display %>%
  mutate(row_id        = row_number(),
         Sample_factor = factor(row_id, levels = rev(row_id)),
         row_parity    = if_else(row_id %% 2 == 1, "odd", "even"),
         group_color   = unname(sample_cols[as.character(sample)]))

# html element for proper colored label display in the table
labels_named <- setNames(sprintf("<span style='color:%s; font-weight:bold'>%s</span>", tbl_df$group_color, tbl_df$Sample_display), tbl_df$Sample_factor)

tbl_long <- tbl_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Total_in, Filter_out, Group_sets, Seqtag_out, AIRR_out, AIRR_prod),
    names_to  = "Step",
    values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(Step = factor(Step, levels = c("Total_in","Filter_out","Group_sets","Seqtag_out","AIRR_out","AIRR_prod")))
```


table as figure
```{r}
table_plot <- ggplot(tbl_long, aes(x = Step, y = Sample_factor)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = row_parity), width = 0.95, height = 0.95, color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(odd = "#F5F5F5", even = "#E0E0E0"), guide = "none") +
  geom_text(aes(label = value), size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = labels_named, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", name = NULL) +
  theme_panel2_table +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 6, hjust = 1))
```
